title: Asking for help – 21 – English at Work gets you the help you need
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】尋求協助 – 21 – 工作英語為您提供所需的協助（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hello, welcome back to Tip Top Trading where everyone is gossiping about Paul's announcement.
cues.en: Hello, welcome back to Tip Top Trading where everyone is gossiping about Paul's announcement.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到 Tip Top Trading，這裡每個人都在討論 Paul 的宣告。

cues.text: Anna is to lead the company's new stock management system for the new laser-curved fruit.
cues.en: Anna is to lead the company's new stock management system for the new laser-curved fruit.
cues.zh: 安娜將負責領導公司針對新型雷射彎曲水果的新庫存管理系統。

cues.text: Yes, Anna. The new girl. She's done really well, although I don't know what experience she's got.
cues.en: Yes, Anna. The new girl. She's done really well, although I don't know what experience she's got.
cues.zh: 是的，安娜。新來的女孩。她做得很好，雖然我不知道她有什麼經驗。

cues.text: Anyway, about the hairdresser you mentioned. Oh, I loved his aftershave.
cues.en: Anyway, about the hairdresser you mentioned. Oh, I loved his aftershave.
cues.zh: 不管怎樣，關於你提到的理髮師。哦，我喜歡他的須後水。

cues.text: I can't understand it. I've got all the experience and all the ideas. She's just such a…
cues.en: I can't understand it. I've got all the experience and all the ideas. She's just such a…
cues.zh: 我無法理解。我擁有所有的經驗和所有的想法。她就是這樣一個…

cues.text: Tom, sorry to interrupt. I just wanted to check you're OK with me leading this strategy for stock management.
cues.en: Tom, sorry to interrupt. I just wanted to check you're OK with me leading this strategy for stock management.
cues.zh: 湯姆，抱歉打擾了。我只是想看看您是否同意我領導這個庫存管理策略。

cues.text: Oh, of course. Yeah, you deserve it.
cues.en: Oh, of course. Yeah, you deserve it.
cues.zh: 哦，當然。是的，你值得擁有。

cues.text: That was a nice touch, Anna.
cues.en: That was a nice touch, Anna.
cues.zh: 這是一個很好的接觸，安娜。

cues.text: But, Tom, now you must help me.
cues.en: But, Tom, now you must help me.
cues.zh: 但是，湯姆，現在你必須幫助我。

cues.text: Eh?
cues.en: Eh?
cues.zh: 呃？

cues.text: Anna, that's not the best way to ask for help.
cues.en: Anna, that's not the best way to ask for help.
cues.zh: 安娜，這不是尋求幫助的最佳方式。

cues.text: Remember what I've always told you about politeness.
cues.en: Remember what I've always told you about politeness.
cues.zh: 記住我一直告訴你的關於禮貌的話。

cues.text: Be polite. Yes, you keep telling me that.
cues.en: Be polite. Yes, you keep telling me that.
cues.zh: 要有禮貌。是的，你一直這麼告訴我。

cues.text: And if you want someone to help you, ask them. Don't tell them. Even if it is, Tom.
cues.en: And if you want someone to help you, ask them. Don't tell them. Even if it is, Tom.
cues.zh: 如果您需要有人幫助您，請詢問他們。不要告訴他們。即使是這樣，湯姆。

cues.text: Oh, right. I'm in a bit of a panic. I've never done this before. I don't know where to begin.
cues.en: Oh, right. I'm in a bit of a panic. I've never done this before. I don't know where to begin.
cues.zh: 哦，對了。我有點恐慌。我以前從未這樣做過。我不知道從哪裡開始。

cues.text: Well, start by asking your colleagues for help, like this.
cues.en: Well, start by asking your colleagues for help, like this.
cues.zh: 好吧，首先向你的同事尋求幫助，就像這樣。

cues.text: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
cues.en: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。

cues.text: Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.en: Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.zh: 請問，我可以向你尋求一些建議嗎？

cues.text: I know you're busy.
cues.en: I know you're busy.
cues.zh: 我知道你很忙。

cues.text: But could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: But could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 但是你能抽出我幾分鐘的時間嗎？

cues.text: Go on. Give it a try.
cues.en: Go on. Give it a try.
cues.zh: 繼續。嘗試一下。

cues.text: Right. Thanks. I'll try.
cues.en: Right. Thanks. I'll try.
cues.zh: 正確的。謝謝。我會盡力。

cues.text: Mmm. Excuse me, Tom. Sorry about earlier.
cues.en: Mmm. Excuse me, Tom. Sorry about earlier.
cues.zh: 嗯。對不起，湯姆。之前的事情很抱歉。

cues.text: I'm a little nervous about leading this strategy thing.
cues.en: I'm a little nervous about leading this strategy thing.
cues.zh: 我對領導這項策略工作有點緊張。

cues.text: And I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please?
cues.en: And I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please?
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。請？

cues.text: Of course, Anna. Why didn't you say? I'd be delighted.
cues.en: Of course, Anna. Why didn't you say? I'd be delighted.
cues.zh: 當然，安娜。為什麼不說？我會很高興。

cues.text: I've lost count of the number of projects I've led over the years.
cues.en: I've lost count of the number of projects I've led over the years.
cues.zh: 我已經記不清這些年來我領導過的專案有多少了。

cues.text: Great. Thanks. So, where do you think I should begin?
cues.en: Great. Thanks. So, where do you think I should begin?
cues.zh: 偉大的。謝謝。那麼，你認為我該從哪裡開始呢？

cues.text: Well, give me a few minutes and I'll just find some of the excellent work I did last year.
cues.en: Well, give me a few minutes and I'll just find some of the excellent work I did last year.
cues.zh: 好吧，請給我幾分鐘時間，我會找到一些我去年所做的出色工作。

cues.text: Basically, you'll just need to copy it. Hold on.
cues.en: Basically, you'll just need to copy it. Hold on.
cues.zh: 基本上，您只需要複製它。堅持，稍等。

cues.text: Oh, Anna. Just popping out for some biscuits.
cues.en: Oh, Anna. Just popping out for some biscuits.
cues.zh: 哦，安娜。只是出去吃一些餅乾。

cues.text: How's the stock management strategy coming along?
cues.en: How's the stock management strategy coming along?
cues.zh: 庫存管理策略進度如何？

cues.text: Oh, very good, Paul.
cues.en: Oh, very good, Paul.
cues.zh: 哦，很好，保羅。

cues.text: Actually, could I ask you for some advice, please?
cues.en: Actually, could I ask you for some advice, please?
cues.zh: 事實上，我可以請你給我一些建議嗎？

cues.text: Yes, of course. Although I don't know if I'll be of much use.
cues.en: Yes, of course. Although I don't know if I'll be of much use.
cues.zh: 是的當然。雖然我不知道我是否會有多大用處。

cues.text: Now, where did I put those damn documents?
cues.en: Now, where did I put those damn documents?
cues.zh: 現在，我把那些該死的檔案放在哪裡了？

cues.text: I'm very grateful for this opportunity, but I'm a little unsure of where to start.
cues.en: I'm very grateful for this opportunity, but I'm a little unsure of where to start.
cues.zh: 我非常感謝這個機會，但我有點不確定從哪裡開始。

cues.text: Tom is looking for some of his old work, but…
cues.en: Tom is looking for some of his old work, but…
cues.zh: 湯姆正在尋找他的一些舊作品，但…

cues.text: Really? To be honest, this isn't Tom's speciality. At a time like this, I would ask Denise.
cues.en: Really? To be honest, this isn't Tom's speciality. At a time like this, I would ask Denise.
cues.zh: 真的嗎？說實話，這不是湯姆的專長。在這種時候，我會問丹妮絲。

cues.text: Denise?
cues.en: Denise?
cues.zh: 丹妮絲？

cues.text: Yes. She may only be the office assistant, but she always has words of wisdom.
cues.en: Yes. She may only be the office assistant, but she always has words of wisdom.
cues.zh: 是的。她也許只是辦公室助理，但她總是有智慧之言。

cues.text: Right. Custard creams or chocolate digestives?
cues.en: Right. Custard creams or chocolate digestives?
cues.zh: 正確的。奶凍還是巧克力消化劑？

cues.text: What?
cues.en: What?
cues.zh: 什麼？

cues.text: Biscuits.
cues.en: Biscuits.
cues.zh: 餅乾。

cues.text: Oh, custard creams, please.
cues.en: Oh, custard creams, please.
cues.zh: 哦，請給我奶凍。

cues.text: Uh, Denise, I know you're busy, but could you spare a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: Uh, Denise, I know you're busy, but could you spare a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 呃，丹尼斯，我知道你很忙，但是你能抽出幾分鐘嗎？

cues.text: Of course, Anna. Always happy to help you.
cues.en: Of course, Anna. Always happy to help you.
cues.zh: 當然，安娜。總是很樂意為您提供協助。

cues.text: Well, you know the stock management control system.
cues.en: Well, you know the stock management control system.
cues.zh: 嗯，您知道庫存管理控制系統。

cues.text: The one you've now got to work out? Well done for getting that.
cues.en: The one you've now got to work out? Well done for getting that.
cues.zh: 你現在要鍛鍊的那個？做得很好。

cues.text: Thanks. It was okay writing it down for Paul. But how do I put it into practice? There's just too much to do.
cues.en: Thanks. It was okay writing it down for Paul. But how do I put it into practice? There's just too much to do.
cues.zh: 謝謝。為保羅寫下來是可以的。但我如何付諸實行呢？有太多事情要做。

cues.text: Calm down, Anna. You'll be fine. The first thing you need to do is look at our current system.
cues.en: Calm down, Anna. You'll be fine. The first thing you need to do is look at our current system.
cues.zh: 冷靜點，安娜。你會沒事的。您需要做的第一件事是檢視我們目前的系統。

cues.text: Look at our current system. How do I do that?
cues.en: Look at our current system. How do I do that?
cues.zh: 看看我們現在的系統。我該怎麼做？

cues.text: Easy. Just take the lift down to the warehouse and speak to Mr. Ingl and then write down what you find
cues.en: Easy. Just take the lift down to the warehouse and speak to Mr. Ingl and then write down what you find
cues.zh: 簡單的。只需搭乘電梯到倉庫並與 Ingl 先生交談，然後寫下您發現的內容

cues.text: and draw up an action plan of tasks you need to do, like a shopping list. I'm very good at those.
cues.en: and draw up an action plan of tasks you need to do, like a shopping list. I'm very good at those.
cues.zh: 並制定您需要完成的任務的行動計劃，例如購物清單。我很擅長這些。

cues.text: Go and see Mr. Ingl. Do I have to?
cues.en: Go and see Mr. Ingl. Do I have to?
cues.zh: 去見英格先生。我必須這樣做嗎？

cues.text: He's okay, really, Anna. If you approach him in the right way, he won't bite your head off.
cues.en: He's okay, really, Anna. If you approach him in the right way, he won't bite your head off.
cues.zh: 他真的很好，安娜。如果你以正確的方式接近他，他就不會咬掉你的頭。

cues.text: What? Bite my head off? Oh, well, if he won't bite me, then I suppose I should go and see him.
cues.en: What? Bite my head off? Oh, well, if he won't bite me, then I suppose I should go and see him.
cues.zh: 什麼？把我的頭咬下來？哦，好吧，如果他不咬我，那我想我應該去看他。

cues.text: Thanks for your advice, Denise. I could kiss you. Right. I'm going to go and see him right now.
cues.en: Thanks for your advice, Denise. I could kiss you. Right. I'm going to go and see him right now.
cues.zh: 謝謝你的建議，丹妮絲。我可以吻你。正確的。我現在就去見他。

cues.text: Make an action plan. A good idea. Well done, Denise. You're smarter than you look.
cues.en: Make an action plan. A good idea. Well done, Denise. You're smarter than you look.
cues.zh: 制定行動計劃。好主意。幹得好，丹妮絲。你比你看起來更聰明。

cues.text: And well done, Anna. You eventually got the help you needed by using these phrases.
cues.en: And well done, Anna. You eventually got the help you needed by using these phrases.
cues.zh: 幹得好，安娜。您最終透過使用這些短語獲得了所需的幫助。

cues.text: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.en: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help. Please, could I ask you for some advice?
cues.zh: 如果您能給我一些幫助，我將不勝感激。請問，我可以向你尋求一些建議嗎？

cues.text: I know you're busy, but could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.en: I know you're busy, but could you spare me a few minutes of your time, please?
cues.zh: 我知道您很忙，但是您能抽出幾分鐘給我嗎？

cues.text: Remember, if you're stuck for ideas, just ask for help. But maybe not, Tom. I wonder how he's getting on.
cues.en: Remember, if you're stuck for ideas, just ask for help. But maybe not, Tom. I wonder how he's getting on.
cues.zh: 請記住，如果您找不到想法，請尋求協助。但也許不是，湯姆。我想知道他過得怎麼樣。

cues.text: Here, Anna, I've got them. Look, all my ideas from my last stock control project. Pages and pages of them.
cues.en: Here, Anna, I've got them. Look, all my ideas from my last stock control project. Pages and pages of them.
cues.zh: 安娜，在這裡，我已經拿到了。看，我所有的想法都來自我上一個庫存控制專案。一頁又一頁。

cues.text: Just copy these. They're brilliant. Anna? Anna!
cues.en: Just copy these. They're brilliant. Anna? Anna!
cues.zh: 只需複製這些即可。他們很聰明。安娜？安娜！

cues.text: Too late. I've just seen her in the lift. Fancy a custard cream, Tom?
cues.en: Too late. I've just seen her in the lift. Fancy a custard cream, Tom?
cues.zh: 為時已晚。我剛剛在電梯裡見過她。湯姆，想要奶凍嗎？

cues.text: So, Anna is off to speak to the prickly Mr. Ingl. Let's hope she uses those phrases to ask for help.
cues.en: So, Anna is off to speak to the prickly Mr. Ingl. Let's hope she uses those phrases to ask for help.
cues.zh: 所以，安娜要去和易怒的英格先生說話。希望她能用這些短語來尋求幫助。

cues.text: Otherwise, she might get her head bitten off. And it could get very messy. See you next time.
cues.en: Otherwise, she might get her head bitten off. And it could get very messy. See you next time.
cues.zh: 不然她的頭可能會被咬掉。它可能會變得非常混亂。下次見。
